title: Present continuous and present simple (2)
summary: Особые случаи: always + continuous для раздражения, present simple в анекдотах, комментариях, инструкциях и заголовках, глаголы-действия (I promise, I apologise), глаголы восприятия и ощущений, смягчающее I'm wondering/hoping.
ru:
## Always + present continuous: эмоция, а не частота
Обычно **always** идёт с present simple и значит «каждый раз». Но с present continuous оно приобретает эмоциональную окраску: говорящего что-то **раздражает** (реже — умиляет или удивляет), и он преувеличивает частоту. То же делают **constantly, forever, continually**.
> My manager is always changing his mind. — Мой начальник вечно меняет решения. (раздражает)
> She's constantly checking her phone during dinner. — Она постоянно проверяет телефон за ужином.
> My son is always bringing home stray cats! — Мой сын вечно тащит домой бродячих кошек! (с улыбкой)
Сравните нейтральное: **My manager always changes his mind on Fridays.** — просто факт. Обратите внимание на порядок слов: **is always doing**, а не ~~always is doing~~.

## Present simple в рассказах, анекдотах и пересказе сюжета
Чтобы рассказ был живее, мы переходим в настоящее время — это «историческое» (narrative) present. Так строят анекдоты, устные истории, пересказ книг и фильмов.
> So I'm standing in the queue, and this guy walks up, pushes in front of me and says nothing. — Так вот, стою я в очереди, подходит какой-то тип, влезает передо мной и молчит.
> In the opening scene, a detective finds a letter hidden in a piano. — В первой сцене детектив находит письмо, спрятанное в рояле.
При пересказе сюжета события идут в present simple, а фон — в present continuous: **While the guests are dancing, the thief slips upstairs.**

## Комментарии, инструкции, заголовки
- **Спортивные и другие комментарии** о быстрых действиях: **Alonso passes to Ruiz, Ruiz shoots — and scores!**
- **Инструкции и рецепты:** **First you heat the oil, then you add the garlic.**
- **Заголовки новостей** (экономят место и дают ощущение «прямо сейчас»): **Minister resigns after leaked report.**

## Глаголы-действия: I promise, I apologise
Некоторые глаголы **сами являются действием**, когда мы их произносим: **promise, apologise, accept, advise, refuse, warn, agree, declare, suggest, thank**. Здесь нужен только present simple.
> I promise I'll be on time. — Обещаю прийти вовремя.
> We regret to inform you that your application has been unsuccessful. — С сожалением сообщаем...
- ~~I'm promising you I won't be late.~~ → I **promise**...

## Восприятие, ощущения, сообщения
С **see, hear, smell, taste** в значении «воспринимаю» часто стоит **can**, а не continuous: **I can hear a noise.** — ~~I'm hearing a noise.~~ Но **feel, hurt, ache, itch** допускают обе формы почти без разницы: **My back hurts. / My back is hurting.**
Для неформальных новостей используем present simple: **I hear / I gather / I understand / I'm told (that)...**
> I gather the project has been postponed. — Насколько я понимаю, проект отложен.

## Смягчение: I'm wondering, I'm hoping
Поставив **wonder, hope, think, look forward** в continuous, мы звучим мягче и вежливее — как будто мысль ещё формируется.
> I'm wondering if you could look at my draft. — Не могли бы вы взглянуть на мой черновик?
> We're hoping to hear from you soon. — Мы рассчитываем скоро получить от вас ответ.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~She always is complaining.~~ → She **is always complaining**.
- ~~I am hearing music.~~ → I **can hear** music.
- ~~I'm apologising for the delay.~~ → I **apologise** for the delay.
en:
## Always + present continuous: emotion, not frequency
Usually **always** goes with present simple and means 'every time'. With present continuous it adds feeling: the speaker is **annoyed** (sometimes amused or surprised) and exaggerates how often something happens. **Constantly, forever, continually** work in the same way.
> My manager is always changing his mind. (annoying)
> She's constantly checking her phone during dinner.
> My son is always bringing home stray cats! (said with a smile)
Compare the neutral **My manager always changes his mind on Fridays.** - just a fact. Mind the word order: **is always doing**, not ~~always is doing~~.

## Present simple in stories, jokes and plot summaries
To make a story more vivid we switch to the present - the 'narrative present'. It is used in jokes, spoken anecdotes and summaries of books and films.
> So I'm standing in the queue, and this guy walks up, pushes in front of me and says nothing.
> In the opening scene, a detective finds a letter hidden in a piano.
In a plot summary the main events are in present simple and the background is in present continuous: **While the guests are dancing, the thief slips upstairs.**

## Commentary, instructions, headlines
- **Commentary** on quick actions (sport, ceremonies): **Alonso passes to Ruiz, Ruiz shoots - and scores!**
- **Instructions and recipes:** **First you heat the oil, then you add the garlic.**
- **News headlines** (short, and they feel immediate): **Minister resigns after leaked report.**

## Performative verbs: I promise, I apologise
Some verbs **are the action** when we say them: **promise, apologise, accept, advise, refuse, warn, agree, declare, suggest, thank**. They need present simple.
> I promise I'll be on time.
> We regret to inform you that your application has been unsuccessful.
- ~~I'm promising you I won't be late.~~ → I **promise**...

## Perception, sensations, reports
With **see, hear, smell, taste** meaning 'perceive' we often use **can**, not the continuous: **I can hear a noise.** - ~~I'm hearing a noise.~~ But **feel, hurt, ache, itch** allow both forms with almost no difference: **My back hurts. / My back is hurting.**
For informal news we use present simple: **I hear / I gather / I understand / I'm told (that)...**
> I gather the project has been postponed.

## Softening: I'm wondering, I'm hoping
Putting **wonder, hope, think, look forward** into the continuous makes us sound softer and more polite, as if the thought is still forming.
> I'm wondering if you could look at my draft.
> We're hoping to hear from you soon.

## Common mistakes
- ~~She always is complaining.~~ → She **is always complaining**.
- ~~I am hearing music.~~ → I **can hear** music.
- ~~I'm apologising for the delay.~~ → I **apologise** for the delay.
structure:
## Формулы
> subject + **be** + **always / constantly / forever** + V-ing → раздражение, преувеличение
> He's always borrowing my tools.

> I / we + **performative verb** (present simple) → действие в момент речи
> I apologise. · We accept. · I warn you.

## Сравнительная таблица
| Ситуация | Форма | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| Нейтральная привычка | always + present simple | She always arrives early. |
| Раздражение / эмоция | be always + V-ing | She's always arriving late! |
| Анекдот, рассказ | present simple (+ continuous для фона) | A man walks into a bar... |
| Пересказ сюжета | present simple | The hero loses his memory. |
| Комментарий | present simple | He passes, she shoots. |
| Инструкция | present simple | You add the flour. |
| Заголовок | present simple | Prices rise again |
| Обещание, извинение | present simple (performative) | I promise. I apologise. |
| Вежливая просьба | I'm wondering / hoping | I'm wondering if you could help. |
| Неформальная новость | present simple | I hear he's moving. |

## Что нельзя
| Неверно | Верно |
|---|---|
| ~~I am hearing a noise.~~ | I can hear a noise. |
| ~~I'm promising.~~ | I promise. |
| ~~She always is leaving.~~ | She is always leaving. |

exercises.title: Особые употребления
exercises.instruction: Поставьте глагол в скобках в present simple или present continuous. В пунктах про раздражение используйте continuous с always/constantly.
exercises.example: He (leave) his socks everywhere — it drives me mad! → He is always leaving his socks everywhere.

items.text: My neighbour {{is always leaving|'s always leaving}} his bins in front of my gate. It drives me mad!
I {{apologise|apologize}} for the delay in replying to your letter.
In the second half Rooney {{passes}} to Sanchez, who {{shoots}} - and it's a goal!
First you {{peel}} the onions, then you {{chop}} them finely.
So this guy {{walks}} into a bar and {{orders}} a drink.
I {{gather}} that the meeting has been postponed until Monday.
I {{promise}} I won't tell anyone your secret.
Our new intern {{is constantly asking|'s constantly asking}} the same question. It's exhausting.
I {{am wondering|'m wondering|wonder|was wondering}} if you could lend me your notes from the lecture.
She {{is always borrowing|'s always borrowing}} my charger without asking.
Listen - I {{hear|can hear}} something in the attic.
The article {{says}} that the deadline is Friday.
In this scene, Hamlet {{finds}} his father's ghost on the battlements.
We {{accept}} your offer, subject to the conditions listed below.
I'm sorry, I {{don't remember|do not remember|can't remember|cannot remember}} your name.
My head {{hurts|aches|is hurting|'s hurting|is aching|'s aching}} - I need to lie down.

exercises.title: Какая форма подходит?
exercises.instruction: Выберите вариант, который лучше всего подходит по смыслу.

items.q: Sam ___ his keys - it's so annoying!
items.why: Раздражение выражаем **is always + V-ing**, причём always стоит после is; always lose не согласуется с Sam (нужно -s).

items.q: I hereby ___ you that the flight has been cancelled.
Mix the dough well. Then you ___ the raisins.
Did you hear? I ___ the CEO is stepping down.
A man walks into a pharmacy and ___ for something strange.
items.why: Анекдот в narrative present: **walks ... and asks**.

items.q: I ___ to apply for the position of project manager.
items.why: В начале делового письма действие происходит прямо сейчас — **I am writing to...**; wrote и have written говорили бы об уже написанном письме.

items.q: I can ___ someone playing the piano next door.
items.why: После can — инфинитив без to: **can hear**.

options: She is always asking for help.
She is asking always for help.
items.why: Always стоит между be и V-ing.

options: I am promising to call you tomorrow.
I promise to call you tomorrow.
items.why: Promise — глагол-действие, используется в present simple.

options: I understand you're moving to Berlin.
I'm understanding you're moving to Berlin.
items.why: I understand = «насколько я знаю»; understand — глагол состояния.

options: The film starts when a detective finds a body.
The film is starting when a detective is finding a body.
He's constantly complaining about the noise.
He constantly is complaining about the noise.
items.why: Наречие стоит после is: **is constantly complaining**.

options: I can hear the phone ringing.
items.why: Глаголы восприятия обычно с can, не в continuous.

exercises.title: Выразите раздражение
exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение, используя always + present continuous, чтобы показать раздражение.

items.prompt: Tom leaves his dirty cups in the sink.
answers: Tom is always leaving his dirty cups in the sink.
Tom's always leaving his dirty cups in the sink.
My sister is always borrowing my clothes.
My sister's always borrowing my clothes.
The printer is always breaking down.
You are always forgetting your password.

items.prompt: Our neighbours play loud music at night.
answers: Our neighbours are always playing loud music at night.
Our neighbours are always playing loud music at night

exercises.title: Рассказ в настоящем времени
exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение в present simple, как в анекдоте или устном рассказе.

items.prompt: A man walked into a bank and asked for a loan.
answers: A man walks into a bank and asks for a loan.

items.prompt: A tourist stopped me and asked for directions.
answers: A tourist stops me and asks for directions.

items.prompt: The detective opened the door and saw a body.
answers: The detective opens the door and sees a body.

items.prompt: She picked up the phone and heard a strange voice.
answers: She picks up the phone and hears a strange voice.

items.prompt: The king died and his son took the throne.
answers: The king dies and his son takes the throne.

items.prompt: He turned around and everyone went silent.
answers: He turns around and everyone goes silent.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте на вопросы полными предложениями на английском.

items.prompt: What does someone close to you always do that annoys you a little? Use is always + -ing.
items.sample: My brother is always leaving the lights on in every room.

items.prompt: Retell the plot of a film or book you like in 3-4 sentences, using present simple.
items.sample: A young engineer finds an old map in her grandfather's attic. She follows it to a remote island, where she discovers a hidden laboratory.

items.prompt: Write a polite request to a colleague using I'm wondering / I'm hoping.
items.sample: I'm wondering if you could send me the report by Thursday.

items.prompt: Give instructions for making your favourite drink (3 steps).
items.sample: First you boil the water. Then you add a spoonful of tea. Finally you pour in some milk.

items.prompt: Write a short newspaper headline about something that happened this week.
items.sample: City opens new bridge after two years of work.
